items.text:
dbow, dblade, dhelm or dring, for a Kog'Maw in NA Challenger?
Stats: coachless.gg and u.gg, NA, patches 16.18 to 16.20
(u.gg calls them 26.x). Item numbers: LoL wiki and
Data Dragon 16.21.1. Pulled 2026-10-23.
Four tabs, four angles. Start at the Verdict or read in order.

+8 AD · +15% attack speed · +1.5% omnivamp
No passive (no Helping Hand).
Added V26.09 (6 AD); AD raised to 8 in V26.10.
heals 8 HP per 10 s of autos

+10 AD · +80 health · +2.5% omnivamp
No passive (Life Draining was folded into omnivamp in
V26.01).
heals 12 HP per 10 s of autos

+150 health · +8 armor · +8 magic resist
Helping Hand: attacks deal 5 bonus physical damage to
minions.

+18 AP · +90 health
Drain: +1 mana per second, 2 per second for 5 s after
hitting a champion. Helping Hand: +5 damage to minions.

Kog makes 105 on his own.
That is 57% to 114% more:
~1.5 to 3.0 extra Q or W a minute.

• Bow is the fight item. +30% level 1 auto DPS for
the cheapest price, because attack speed multiplies
Kog's 61 base AD. Blade gives +16% for 50g more.
• Helm is the survive item: about +32% effective HP
against both damage types, for a champion with 635
HP and 24 armor at level 1 and no dash.
• Ring is the mana item. Kog's Q, W, E and R all
cost 40+ mana and his own regen is 105 a minute. The
18 AP adds only 0.27% max health to each W hit
(about 2 damage on a 650 HP laner), but it also
feeds E and R.
• Blade looks worst for Kog: less DPS than Bow, less
bulk than Helm. Its 80 HP and 2.5% omnivamp are
built for melee fighters. Omnivamp heals ~12 HP per
10 s of level 1 autos, so it is not a sustain item
at this level.

Assumptions: level 1, no runes, no Q passive, target with 0
armor for DPS.
Bulk = effective HP vs Kog with no item (HP × (1 +
resist/100)).
Gold values: the LoL wiki cost analysis.

WPA in percentage points, 3 patches added together (game-weighted).
Dot = pooled WPA. Whisker = rough 95% noise from the game count alone.
Green or red only when the whole whisker is on one side of zero.
"by patch" lists 16.18 / 16.19 / 16.20.

• Ring's share climbs with rank in NA: 16% → 36% →
59% (Gold+ → Diamond+ → Master+).
• NA Master+: Ring +2.4 vs Bow −3.4, a 5.7 pp gap
at 2.1× its noise. Ring was ahead in 2 of 3
patches, on only ~1.4K games.
• NA Diamond+: Ring ahead by 1.6 pp (1.2×). A
lean, not a result.
• World Diamond+ (57.7K games): Bow ahead of Ring
by 0.5 pp (0.9×). Basically a tie.
• Helm and Blade: 1.6K and 2.9K world Diamond+
games, both a little under zero, inside the noise.
Too rare in NA high elo to show.
• Why NA Master+ is so different from the world:
see tab 3. It is mostly a different build, not
just a different starter.
Up the ranks, Kog turns AP and starts Ring

Builds are defined by finished items, so they skip short stomps and lean toward longer games;
compare builds with each other, not with 50%. Variants overlap a little.
u.gg names one starter per build: its best scorer, not always the most bought.
Grey "(n g)" = u.gg picked a rare starter there, so the usual one is unknown.

• NA Challenger Kog is mostly AP now: 71% of 1,173
games build Dusk and Dawn first, against 17% at
All ranks.
• Those AP games start Ring 83% of the time.
On-hit games start Bow when there is enough data
(All ranks: 84%).
• Challenger, Ring vs every other start: 53.2%
(678 g) vs 45.5% (495 g), 2.6× the noise.
• So the starter question is really a build
question: Ring is the AP start. At Challenger the
AP build sits at 52.1% vs on-hit 47.8% (only 249
on-hit games).
• Lower down it flips: at All ranks on-hit wins
56.7% vs AP 50.2%. AP Kog looks like the harder
build that pays off in skilled hands.
• Caveat: NA Master+ Kog games come from a few
one-tricks with hundreds of games each (u.gg
leaderboard). Their skill is baked into these
numbers.
Kog'Maw ADC in NA Challenger. My pick:
First decide the build. The starter follows it.

AP for W, E and R, and Drain adds 57% to Kog's
mana regen (114% while trading), so he can
keep casting E and W. It is what NA Challenger
Kogs start, and it wins there (tab 3).

+30% level 1 auto DPS for 400g, the most
gold-efficient starter (181%), and its attack
speed is what the on-hit build wants. Top
pooled WPA in world Diamond+ (tab 2), by a
hair.

About +32% effective HP vs both damage types
at level 1. Take it into lanes that can kill
Kog before he scales (heavy level 2 all-ins,
double poke). Rare in the data, so this is
reasoning, not stats.

Less DPS than Bow and less bulk than Helm, for
more gold than Bow. The data can't separate it
from the others (tab 2), so this one rests on
the lane math. No Kog lane wants exactly this
mix.

• Ring for AP and Bow for on-hit: confident. The
item stats line up with each build and the data
agrees.
• AP Kog being the better build in NA Challenger: a
lean. AP beat on-hit in 2 of 3 patches, on a few
hundred games from a handful of players.
• Helm into kill lanes: an educated guess. Too few
Helm games to test.

• Matchups: Ring vs Bow into Draven, Lucian, Caitlyn
(coachless "vs" filter, once samples allow).
• AP vs on-hit Kog by enemy comp: tanky teams should
favour %HP W either way.
• Re-pull when 26.21 has a full patch of games.
